description: Aires de stationnement public - Saint-Hyacinthe is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Saint-Hyacinthe. Couche de surfaces des aires de stationnement publics de la ville. Contexte de collecte Mise à jour par les techniciens du service du génie. Méthode de collecte Dessin technique. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Saint-Hyacinthe. It offers 2 resource(s) in ESRIREST, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2025-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
